name: skill-activation-registry
purpose: Tracks which repository-managed Codex skills should be available for automatic activation, where their installed copies live, and whether trigger descriptions and installed files are in sync with source.

reader_guide.summary: Open this file when a skill does not appear to auto-apply. It distinguishes source-ready skills from installed trigger-ready skills and gives the validation command for drift checks.
how_to_read: Read skills to see each repository skill source path and installed Codex path.
auto_activation_expected=true means the skill should exist under CODEX_HOME/skills and be kept in sync with source.
trigger_examples are realistic prompts that should cause the skill to be selected automatically or with an explicit skill mention.
sync_files are compared between source and installed copy by check-skill-activation.
update_triggers: A repository-managed skill is created, renamed, removed, installed, or uninstalled.
A SKILL.md description or trigger scope changes.
A user reports that a skill did not auto-apply when expected.
A repository skill source is updated and the installed Codex copy must be re-synced.

reference_links.title: Using skills
used_for: skills need names, descriptions, workflow instructions, resources, and clear reusable workflow scope

reference_links.title: Plugins and skills
used_for: Codex can use skills explicitly or automatically based on the task

reference_links.title: Skill Lifecycle Policy
used_for: repository skill source, validation, forward-test, and installation record rules

structure_rules.rule: A skill under _skills/ is source-ready only; it is not expected to auto-trigger unless auto_activation_expected is true and installed_path exists.
structure_rules.reason: The user observed that skills were not auto-applying even though source folders existed.

structure_rules.rule: When auto_activation_expected is true, every path in sync_files must match between source_path and installed_path.
structure_rules.reason: Codex reads installed skills, so source improvements do not help auto activation if the installed copy drifts.

structure_rules.rule: Each skill must keep at least two realistic trigger examples.
structure_rules.reason: Frontmatter descriptions are short; trigger examples make activation expectations inspectable and testable.

structure_rules.rule: The source SKILL.md description must include 'Use when' or 'Use for' and be long enough to identify the task boundary.
structure_rules.reason: Automatic selection depends heavily on clear skill descriptions.

field_guide.meaning: Repository-managed custom skills and their activation expectations.
Whether the skill should be installed into CODEX_HOME/skills and available for automatic task matching.
Prompts that should activate the skill.
Prompts that should not activate the skill because another asset or normal coding flow is better.
Files compared between source and installed copy to detect drift.

skills.name: create-validated-skill
trigger_examples: 스킬 자동 적용이 잘 안 되는 것 같아. trigger와 설치 상태를 점검해서 개선해줘.
Create a repository-managed Codex skill for this repeated workflow and validate it.
이 반복 작업을 검증된 Codex skill로 만들고 설치 준비까지 해줘.
negative_examples: 이미 있는 일반 workflow 문서만 찾아줘.

skills.name: presentation-reference-curator
trigger_examples: 발표 에이전트용 예쁜 PPT와 HTML 발표 레퍼런스를 많이 모아줘.
Collect presentation design references, licensing status, reusable assets, and PPTX-to-HTML conversion options.
발표 자료를 만들기 전에 좋은 디자인 사례, 에셋 출처, 변환 가능성을 조사해서 카탈로그로 정리해줘.
negative_examples: 이미 정해진 슬라이드 문구만 맞춤법 검사해줘.
프레젠테이션과 무관한 일반 웹 리서치를 해줘.
